umad-2026.name: UMAD 2026
umad-2026.location: 550 Rue Richmond, Montréal, QC H3J 1V3, Canada
umad-2026.description:
UMAD 2026 (Ultimate Montreal Airdashers) returns for another edition, bringing together the fighting game community for a multi-day celebration of competitive play across a wide lineup of titles, with Street Fighter 6 among the featured games.

Organized by the Montreal Airdashers, the event is known for its passionate community atmosphere. Registration and the latest information are available on the official Start.gg event page.

ragnarok-tournament-2026.name: Ragnarok Tournament 2026
ragnarok-tournament-2026.location: Algarrobo 1041, C1293ABA Cdad. Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina
ragnarok-tournament-2026.description:
Ragnarok Tournament 2026 serves as Argentina's flagship annual gathering for competitive fighting games, established by Valquiria Esports to unite the South American scene under one roof. The weekend provides a premier proving ground for regional contenders testing their skills in Street Fighter 6 against top bracket talent from across the continent.

The tournament represents one of the most prominent open competitions on the South American calendar. Entrants battle through a double-elimination bracket where match composure and high-level execution determine regional supremacy.

Lineup and Festival Scope

Alongside the primary singles schedule, the festival hosts major brackets for TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, and Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising. The event floor also features expansive free-play setups, retro fighting game tournaments, and a dedicated cosplay competition.

takedown-2026.name: Takedown 2026
takedown-2026.location: Packages Mall, Walton Rd, Walton Railway Officers Colony, Lahore, Pakistan
takedown-2026.description:
Takedown 2026 stands as Pakistan's premier fighting game tournament, organized by BAAZ to bring regional and international competitors together under one roof in South Asia. The multi-game major establishes a central proving ground for the local scene, featuring open bracket competition in Street Fighter 6 alongside elite global circuit stops.

Competitors clash through a double-elimination bracket where precise fundamentals and tournament endurance decide the outcome. With regional prestige on the line, the bracket offers a vital platform for rising contenders to make their mark against established tournament veterans.

Lineup and Event Scope

Alongside the featured singles action, the tournament hosts official circuit stops for TEKKEN 8 and Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves. The weekend schedule also includes open competition in EA Sports FC 26, rounding out a packed competitive roster for South Asian esports.

treta-championship-2026.name: Treta Championship 2026
treta-championship-2026.location: Av. Rui Barbosa, 4997 - Iná, São José dos Pinhais - PR, 83045-350, Brasil
treta-championship-2026.venueName: Sport and Leisure Center Max Rosenmann
treta-championship-2026.description:
Treta Championship 2026 stands as Brazil's premier and longest-running fighting game festival, bringing together the South American fighting game community for high-level open competition. The annual gathering serves as a pillar for the continental scene, drawing elite contenders to test their mettle in Street Fighter 6 across a multi-day championship weekend.

The tournament provides a critical competitive arena for South American fighters looking to establish regional supremacy. Competitors battle through an intense double-elimination open bracket where split-second reaction times and deep matchup knowledge decide who lifts the trophy.

Lineup and Event Scope

Beyond the headline tournament, the venue hosts competitive brackets for TEKKEN 8, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, Guilty Gear -Strive-, and Mortal Kombat 1. The festival floor also features extensive casual setups, retro tournament brackets, and dedicated exhibition spaces for the broader community.

ultimate-fighting-arena-2026-2.name: Ultimate Fighting Arena 2026
ultimate-fighting-arena-2026-2.location: 87 Avenue des Magasins Généraux, 93300 Aubervilliers, France
ultimate-fighting-arena-2026-2.description:
Ultimate Fighting Arena 2026 stands as Europe's flagship fighting game major, anchoring the continental calendar with top-tier international competition across the genre. Established as a premier proving ground for global talent, the gathering brings together competitors from every major region to contest Street Fighter 6 under high-stakes tournament conditions.

The tournament holds major weight on the international circuit as a designated Capcom Pro Tour Premier stop. A victory in the premier bracket guarantees direct qualification to the championship tournament held early next year, making every phase of the open bracket a critical test for world-class title hopefuls.

Lineup and Event Scope

Alongside the flagship singles bracket, the weekend hosts extensive team competitions including the 3v3 format as well as major tournaments for TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, and Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. Attendees also have access to expansive free-play setups, retro arcade areas, and dedicated spaces for community exhibitions.

ozhadou-nationals-20.name: OzHadou Nationals 20
ozhadou-nationals-20.description:
OzHadou Nationals 20 marks the milestone twentieth edition of Australia's longest-running fighting game major, carrying on a competitive tradition established at the dawn of the country's organized scene. As the premier gathering for the Oceanian fighting game community, the tournament draws top talent from across the region to clash in Street Fighter 6 under full championship conditions.

The tournament serves as a vital proving ground for continental supremacy. Contenders battle through an intense double-elimination open bracket where composure, deep character knowledge, and clutch execution decide who claims the historic title.

Lineup and Event Scope

Alongside the featured singles competition, the weekend hosts open brackets across a broad multi-game roster including TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, and Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves. Attendees also have access to dedicated free-play stations and community-run side events throughout the venue.

island-paradise-3.description:

Registration and the latest information are available on the official Start.gg event page.

drowning-pools-2026.description:
Drowning Pools 2026 brings the Merseyside FGC community together for a day of fighting game competition in Liverpool, with Street Fighter 6 featured alongside a wider multi-game lineup.
